names.en: J-source ideograph removed from CJK A

title: The J-source ideograph removed from the CJK A candidate
scope: The single ideograph that IRGN424 removes from Japan's CJK A proposal revision 5 (IRGN346), printed as A-2360. The document also states that the proposal then held 661 ideographs. A-2360 is a proposal code, and no published Unicode scalar is claimed for it.

documents.title: Modification of Japanese Proposed Repertoire for IRG Vertical Extension-A
documents.status: Removes one ideograph, A-2360, from the Japanese Extension A proposal revision 5 at the Singapore 1997 meeting, leaving 661 proposed characters. The document prints no glyph and no scalar for it.
